title: Copilot connectors: how does outside data reach Copilot, and who can see it?
summary: The page passes: Microsoft's documentation supports its licensing, permission choices, connector controls and automation calls. Two minor corrections remain: cite the source distinguishing Power Platform connectors, and acknowledge the differing administrator-role requirements on Microsoft's setup pages.
